args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully; monitoring continues.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the failure and the rollback action.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0, healthy in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.

Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, so v2.3.1 should be investigated before any future production attempt.
